# Reporting a security problem

If you find a vulnerability in the Digital Office (DGO), please tell us privately before anyone else:

- **On GitHub:** the public repository's **Security** tab → **Report a vulnerability**
  (<https://github.com/bina-solution/digital-office/security/advisories/new>). Only the maintainers see it.
- **If that button is not there:** open an issue titled «security contact», with no details in it, and we will
  reach you privately.
- Please do not publish the problem itself — in an issue, a pull request or a discussion — until a fix is out.

What helps us most: the version or commit you ran, what you did, what happened, and what you expected —
a request and its answer, or the lines of a log, are better than a description of them. Never send a real
password, token or customer document; a made-up one shows the problem as well.

We answer every report, say whether we can reproduce it, and say when the fix is published.

**Which version:** the newest commit of the public repository's `main`. A fix arrives as a newer one.
